projects.title: Authentication transfer: trusted principal
projects.completeScope: Extract only a supplied trusted principal with nonblank string id and known role member/moderator/admin. Ignore a separate untrusted request body, even if it requests an admin role. This models one trust boundary; no password, session or real login is implemented.

projects.title: Authorization: owner versus role
projects.completeScope: For a supplied server-loaded report implement READ for owner/moderator/admin and DELETE for owner/admin. Missing report and unrelated READ give 404; unauthenticated gives 401; unrelated DELETE gives403. Ignore body privileges. This narrow pure policy leaves submit/resolve/loading errors and Express middleware unqualified.

projects.title: CORS and CSRF: two independent decisions
projects.completeScope: Compute exact-origin sharing permission separately from the unsafe cookie-authenticated request token check. Safe methods GET/HEAD/OPTIONS or bearer authentication do not require a CSRF match in this bounded API. Do not record token values in the PDF. Browser CORS enforcement, cache behaviour and timing safety remain untested.

contract_explanations.P01: Output selected id/role values and unchanged input content; valid nonblank IDs remain raw. No additional result-reference freshness or own-property restriction.
contract_explanations.P02: Only read/delete with supplied principal/report; absent principal401 precedes absent report404. The body cannot alter action, role or ownership. No resource load or deletion is performed.
contract_explanations.P03: Exact membership of supplied origin strings; no URL normalisation. auth is cookie/bearer, tokenMatches a Boolean and declared uppercase methods use the stated exemptions. Sharing and request-token decisions remain independent.

finite_witness_scope.limit: Finite pure-function contract, not login/HTTP/browser/TLS/timing; no return-reference identity requirement or added own-property/prototype constraint
